ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Fill in the blank with the organism that is a primary consumer: ____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is "MARINE FOOD WEB". The bottom is labeled "Plankton", directly above it is labeled "Razor Clam", and there is an arrow pointing upward from Plankton to Razor Clam. The image also shows Razor Clam connected with other organisms, forming a marine food web. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the eater. Primary consumers are organisms that directly eat producers. Plankton is located at the bottom of the food web, and Razor Clam directly obtains energy from Plankton, therefore Razor Clam is a primary consumer.
